text:
Haris (Finance Ops): Reseller 'EdgeWorks' flagged that AWS marketplace settlement charged retail price even though partner discount code PW-EDGE20 should have applied for promo period. Partner says customers were charged $200 each instead of $160. Need to validate and issue credit.

Nadia (Partner Ops): Which settlement run? can you paste the export snippet? also need original promo terms and dates.

Haris (Finance Ops): Settlement run AWS-2024-11-15. CSV extract:

```
subscription_id,sku,quantity,unit_price,discount_code
sub_e01,aws-edge-pro,10,200,
sub_e01,aws-edge-pro,10,200,
```

Promo PW-EDGE20 active 2024-11-01 to 2024-11-14. Partner claims onboarding applied late so discount not present in export. Overcharge = 10 seats * $40 = $400 per duplicated row? Wait looks like two identical rows were billed for same period; net overcharge likely $800. Need to confirm which rows map to promo period.

Marcus (Revenue Ops): If promo dates align then we should credit $800 gross. Check marketplace fee withholding (AWS policy 12%). Partner commission is 22% normally but commission reversal applies on refunds. Also need audit trail: promo agreement, original invoice INV-AWS-1101-EW, and settlement id.

Clara (Accounting): For >$500 we need Director approval. This is $800 gross — please route to Revenue Director. Also prepare JE lines: reverse revenue $800 DR, reverse commission accrual $176 CR (22%), record marketplace withholding payable $96 CR (12%). Attach promo T&C.

Billing Bot: Created FIN-5150: "AWS promo not applied - EdgeWorks". Assigned to @haris and @clara.

Nadia (Partner Ops): Reached out to partner; they provided signed promo T&C and proof that discount was communicated to AWS at enablement. Uploading doc to FIN-5150.

Marcus (Revenue Ops): Looping in Jordan (Revenue Director) for approval. @Jordan can you approve $800 gross credit and manual rebill flow? We plan to issue credit memo then request AWS marketplace adjustment; mark netsuite credit as provisional until AWS confirms reimbursement.

Haris (Finance Ops): Draft credit memo CM-5150-1 prepared. Will flag as provisional. Nadia, please escalate with AWS partner billing for adjustment and settlement reissue reference.

Jordan (Revenue Director): Approve provisional credit up to $1,000 for partner-facing remedy. Ensure accounting is cc'd and include reclaim clause if AWS reimburses.

Clara (Accounting): Will post provisional credit memo once CM file and promo T&C attached. JE template ready. Please record marketplace settlement case id when available.

Billing Bot: FIN-5150 status -> "provisional credit posted" CM-5150-1.

Haris (Finance Ops): Posting done, tagged FIN-5150. We'll monitor AWS case and reclaim if reimbursed. Notifying EdgeWorks now. :white_check_mark:
